Write a Python script in `/workspace` that chunks the numbers
from `numbers: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` into groups of two.

Use `pyt` if the Design Phase library is installed, otherwise use
`more-itertools` if it is available in the dependency cache, otherwise use a
self-contained fallback. Print a `CUTOVER_CHECK pyt:01_step mode=<mode>` line
before the JSON result.
